arguments.reason: A deeper signed commitment exists: CM-BIG (2000 units, price tier 800) vs CM-A (600 units, price tier 900). The order for 600 units at 900 does not reflect the genuinely deeper signed commitment available.
arguments.conflicts: CM-A vs CM-BIG: customer has two valid signed, unexpired commitments. CM-BIG offers better pricing (800 vs 900) and the ordered units (600) fall within the deeper commitment (2000 units).
